For \(k=1\): \((x+\frac1x)^2\) has constant term \(\binom21=2\), so contribution is \(\binom31(-2)^1\cdot 2=-12\).

For \(k=2\): \((x+\frac1x)^1\) has no constant term.

For \(k=3\): \((x+\frac1x)^0\) has constant term \(1\), so contribution is \((-2)^3=-8\).

Total constant term: \(0-12+0-8=-20\).

\[
\boxed{-20}
\]
